The claim states that the system computes the Cartesian product of all attribute values for each type. The evidence in Source [S1] explicitly supports this in multiple places: 1) Under 'Variant models', it states, 'After you assigned attributes to a type, the inspector will show you a list of models for every combination of states.' 2) Under 'Model names and numerical IDs', it confirms, 'They are automatically generated based on all the combinations of all attributes you gave to each type.' The phrase 'every combination' and 'all the combinations' is synonymous with computing the Cartesian product of the attribute values.
